left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  COPD diagnostic
  -  Both sex
  -  18 <Age <80 years old
  -  LTOT- group : PaO2  [AND] ≥ 65 mmHg and SaO2≥ 92%
  -  LTOT+ group: long term oxygenotherapy prescribed for more than 3 months, with daily use between 12 and 15 hours

right.raw_text:
Patients in both groups will be matched for age (± 5 years), sex  [AND] and physical activity
estimated by GPAQ questionnaire (± 15% Mets

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Recent cardiorespiratory exacerbation (<6 weeks)

right.raw_text:
-  Pulmonary rehabilitation program during the last 2 months
  -  Continuous LTOT  [OR] (24 hours) or deambulation O2 therapy alone
  -  Anticoagulant drugs
  -  Hematocrit outside the normal range (35-50%)
